patch_description: Introduce a CRY ring entanglement on the same outer perimeter as the existing CRX ring. This adds richer inter-qubit correlations by interleaving controlled-Y rotations around the ring, using a shared parameter "cry_ring" for all eight edges. This augments the entanglement motif without drastically increasing circuit depth, potentially improving expressivity and generalization. Parameter sharing keeps the parameter count modest (one additional parameter key per block), resulting in 78 total parameters (up from 72) and a slightly deeper but more powerful ring structure.
